SELECT typeof(s.weight_kg) AS storage_type, MIN(s.weight_kg) AS min_weight,
       COUNT(*) AS heroes, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_weights,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.colour, ', ') FROM main.colour AS c WHERE c.colour IN ('No Colour', 'Blue')) AS categories
FROM main.superhero AS s
GROUP BY typeof(s.weight_kg)
